hooks.command: node -e "const f=process.env.CLAUDE_FILE||''; if(f.includes('pages/game.js')) { console.log('[hook] game.js changed — run yarn dev and open localhost:3000/game to test'); }"
node -e "const f=process.env.CLAUDE_FILE||''; if(f.includes('locales/en.js')) { console.log('[hook] en.js updated — remember to add the matching key in locales/fr.js'); }"
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ "${f%.js}" != "$f" ] && node_modules/.bin/next lint --file "$f" 2>&1; } || true
